title: Variable Pulse Delay
text: 按受控且连续可变的量延迟采样，输入 2 路、输出 1 路；{Initial Input} 指定仿真前输出端口处的值、{Buffer Size} 指定仿真期间可用的输入缓冲样本数，按实例取值。

ports.name: in
ports.summary: 输入采样数据 fixed step discrete sample | variable step discrete sample

ports.name: delay
ports.summary: 向输入信号引入延迟 nonnegative scalar

ports.name: out
ports.summary: 延迟后的输出采样 fixed step discrete sample | variable step discrete sample

params.name: Initial Input
params.values: 仿真前输出端口处的值 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Buffer Size
params.values: 仿真期间可用的输入缓冲样本数 1 (default) | positive scalar integer
